entries.zh: 正是；确实如此；端端正正（將將）
entries.en: it is so; indeed; exactly, just so (chiang-chin, precisely)
entries.notes: 西语 así es 与汉字 将 对应清晰，但闽南音写含 chiáng chīn sī 与 chūn chīn 两组，第二组或为将将（端正貌），展开依赖推断。

entries.zh: 就是那样；跟那个一样
entries.en: it is so with that one; like that thing

entries.zh: 就是这样，像这一类
entries.en: it is so with this, like these sorts of things

entries.zh: 跟那个一样；像那个
entries.en: it is so with that one

entries.zh: 即；就是；如同
entries.en: namely, that is; just as, like

entries.zh: 就像这样大；这么大
entries.en: as big as this; of this size

entries.zh: 如；如同
entries.en: as, like; in the manner of

entries.zh: 如此如彼；这样那样
entries.en: thus and so, like this or like that

entries.zh: 如常；照平常一样
entries.en: as usual, ordinarily

entries.zh: 犹；还是；如同
entries.en: still, yet; as, just as
entries.notes: 汉字犹、闽南音 iū 与西语 así como（如此）对应稍宽，犹在此或作如/仍讲。

entries.zh: 犹然；仍然这样；还是如此
entries.en: still thus; even so, yet in this manner

entries.zh: 宛；宛然；仿佛，恰似
entries.en: just like it; as if, seemingly; to resemble
entries.notes: 西语 así como el; para essele, en algo 语义模糊，汉字宛以仿佛/宛如义最贴合；音写含多组读法，判断依赖推断。

entries.zh: 宛然；活像；一模一样
entries.en: just as if it were it; exactly alike, verily like
entries.notes: 西语 así como el, para id°.（同上/同一）以宛然（宛如其人）释之，属推断展开。

entries.zh: 浑；浑然似；相像而有差别
entries.en: similar but with some difference; whole, undivided
entries.notes: 西语 más difiereia（有差异）与汉字浑搭配不合常规语义，释义存疑。

entries.zh: 浑然；浑然一体；一样命运、同样遭遇
entries.en: wholly alike, undifferentiated; of the same lot
entries.notes: 西语 de la misma suerte（同样命运）以浑然之浑整义对应，稍间接。

entries.zh: 浑成；浑然无别；不分彼此
entries.en: undifferentiated, all one, without distinguishing

entries.zh: 向；是吗？如此？（发问语）
entries.en: thus? so? (interrogative particle)
entries.notes: 西语 así? preguntando 表疑问，汉字向与闽南音 hìō̃ hō 或作发问语气词，非实体义，判断依赖推断。

entries.zh: 向好；也这样吗？还是好的？
entries.en: is it also so? thus still good?
entries.notes: 西语 así tambien? 与汉字向好组合，向作语气/依然解，语义贴合度中等。

entries.zh: 向状样；照那个样子；那般模样
entries.en: in that manner, after that fashion
entries.notes: 汉字向狀樣（状、样并列）与西语 de aquella manera 对应，但西语文本拼写讹误（dea quello），依赖推断。

entries.zh: 譬；比如；譬如如比如何，如此如彼
entries.en: for example, comparing: like this, like that

entries.zh: 譬親像；比如就像；打个比方
entries.en: for example, just as; by way of comparison

entries.zh: 按障生；按这样生（作）；就这样做
entries.en: in this way, after this manner
entries.notes: 汉字按障生（按这样生）与西语 de esta manera 对应，生或作语助/生成讲，展开依赖推断。

entries.zh: 按向生；按那样生；照那样做
entries.en: in that way, after that manner
entries.notes: 同22，按向生与西语 de aquella manera 对应，向或作那样解。

entries.zh: 親像；就像；如此如同；正是这样
entries.en: just as, like; is it so?
